# Royal Marriage arapaho Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_napu_events.9103
	title = cosmo_napu_events.9103.t
	desc = cosmo_napu_events.9103.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_NA_MENU_9A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}
				random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_na_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = arapaho
				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_napu_events.9103.a 
		trigger = {
		has_regency = no 	
		OR = {
			has_consort = no	
			has_estate = estate_harem 	
			has_estate = estate_wives 	
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 	
			has_estate = estate_ooku 				
		}
		}
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_napu_events.91098
			}
		}				
	}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_napu_events.9103.b 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_napu_events.91098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		option = {#uncleson
		name = cosmo_napu_events.9103.c 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_napu_events.91098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}	
		option = {#reject
		name = cosmo_napu_events.9103.7 
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		
}

# Royal Marriage arapaho Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_napu_events.9101
	title = cosmo_napu_events.9101.t
	desc = cosmo_napu_events.9101.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_NA_MENU_9A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = south_america_superregion
				superregion = north_america_superregion
				superregion = central_america_superregion
				superregion = africa_superregion
				superregion = southern_africa_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_possible_here
		}
		every_subject_country = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = south_america_superregion
				superregion = north_america_superregion
				superregion = central_america_superregion
				superregion = africa_superregion
				superregion = southern_africa_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_possible_here
		}			
		}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}				
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					capital_scope = {
			OR = {
				superregion = south_america_superregion
				superregion = north_america_superregion
				superregion = central_america_superregion
				superregion = africa_superregion
				superregion = southern_africa_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
				superregion = eastern_europe_superregion
				superregion = europe_superregion
			}
						has_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_possible_here
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}	
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_napu_events.9101.a 
		FROM = {
			capital_scope = { #testdelete
			set_province_flag = arapaho_honeymoon_first_stop	
			}
		}
		create_marriage = FROM
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}				
		define_consort = {
			country_of_origin = FROM
			dynasty = FROM
			religion = FROM
			culture = FROM
			female = yes
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_nawives_9a
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				FROM = {
					NOT = {
				cosmo_na_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
					}
				}				
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_na_personal_union_I	
					subject = FROM	
					}
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = FROM
				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM	
				FROM = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = cosmo_napu_events.91031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {
			set_country_flag = arapaho_ruler_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}
		cosmo_heir_married = {
			set_country_flag = arapaho_heir_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
			}
		royal_marriage_uncleson = {
			set_country_flag = arapaho_uncle_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
			}
		}
		}			
	}		
}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_na_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

				OR = {
				primary_culture = cheyenne
				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}

		option = {
		name = cosmo_napu_events.92013.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
				OR = {
					advisor = army_reformer 	
					advisor = army_organiser 	
					advisor = grand_captain 	
					advisor = commandant 	
					advisor = quartermaster 	
					advisor = recruitmaster 	
					advisor = fortification_expert 	 	
				}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = cosmo_no_mil_advisor_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					mil_power = 50					
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = cosmo_no_mil_power_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					advisor = army_reformer 	
					advisor = army_organiser 	
					advisor = grand_captain 	
					advisor = commandant 	
					advisor = quartermaster 	
					advisor = recruitmaster 	
					advisor = fortification_expert 	 	
				}
					mil_power = 50					
			}
			add_mil_power = -50	
			event_target:personalunion = {
				add_mil_power = 50
				country_event = {
					id = cosmo_sendmiladvisor_events.1
					}																												
				add_liberty_desire = -15
				add_trust = {
					who = ROOT
					value = 15
					mutual = yes
				}			
			}
		}
		event_target:personalunion = {			
				hidden_effect = {
					remove_opinion = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_military_aid
					}
				}						
		}				
	}	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_napu_events.92013.b
		trigger = {
		event_target:personalunion = {
			capital_scope = {
				NOT = {
			has_province_modifier = cosmo_fortifications
				}
			}
		}			
		}
		add_mil_power = -100
		event_target:personalunion = {
			add_trust = {
				who = ROOT
				value = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					liberty_desire = 25
				}
				add_liberty_desire = -15			
			}						
		add_mil_power = 100
			capital_scope = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
			name = cosmo_fortifications
			duration =  18250

			}
			}
			remove_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_sending_military_aid
			}			
		}		
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoNAWivesNineBCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoNAWivesNineBCounter	
			value = 280
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoNAWivesNineBCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}
		option = {#send troops
		name = cosmo_napu_events.92013.c
		trigger = {
		event_target:personalunion = {
		NOT = {
			has_country_modifier = cosmo_foreign_training
		}	
		}			
		}
		custom_tooltip = cosmo_training_troops_decision_tt 
			clr_country_flag = cosmo_has_artillery
		if = {
			limit = {
				mil_tech = 7 
			}
			set_country_flag = cosmo_has_artillery
		}
		add_mil_power = -50
		add_manpower = 10
		event_target:personalunion = {
		add_mil_power = 50
			add_trust = {
				who = ROOT

			}

			}

		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}

			any_owned_province = {
				has_port = yes

		}
		custom_tooltip = cosmo_building_ships_decision_tt

		event_target:personalunion = {

			remove_opinion = {

			}

				}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion

		}

		}
